trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 are done — it has no task of its own.

steps.t: Finish the story first: 12 of the 54 sit in the main missions and chapters, and free roam opens after the final mission.
Work the 100% checklist next — A Long Road is the biggest single chunk, and most other trophies fall out of it.
Mop up Strangers & Freaks and any counters left (stunts, scans, meditations), then the platinum unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The opening mission of Chapter 1. Story only — it unlocks when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1, through to the end.
No choice or side task is needed; it is the story's first trophy.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Do the balcony meditation before the chapter closes — it is the only thing in Chapter 1 that can go away.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops a little after the chapter ends — the first chapter trophies land once you clear the first mission or two of the next chapter.
Before the chapter closes, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here both characters can roam together, which opens the partner trophies.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops shortly after the chapter rolls over.
By now both characters can roam together, which opens partner trophies such as Hot Together.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is where the Snap Gun and the dye pack jammer arrive.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3.
Chapter 3 is where the Snap Gun arrives (needed for Sneakthief) and the dye pack jammer unlocks (needed for Dime on the Dollar).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission here.

steps.t: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4.
Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4 — start Maximum Withdrawal here.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The final story mission. Free roam continues afterwards, and the 100% checklist appears.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission in Chapter 5. Free roam continues afterwards, so nothing is cut off.
After the credits, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, then Stats.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A Chapter 2 main mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 main mission. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission, in story order as the lists print it. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission Child's Play in Chapter 4 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission, in story order as the lists print it. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission Headliners in Chapter 4 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A Chapter 4 main mission, in story order as the lists print it. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A Chapter 5 main mission, the last of the six mission trophies. It unlocks automatically when the mission ends.

steps.t: Play the main mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 through to the end.
It unlocks automatically with the mission — no extra objective.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The 100% Completion gold — the biggest single chunk of the platinum. The checklist only appears after the story, and most of the platinum's 200 hours sit here.

steps.t: Finish the story first: the checklist only appears after the final mission, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion.
PowerPyx calls the checklist lenient — closer to 60% true completion. You need 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations and 300 stunts.
Robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything; card sets need 15 of 18.
Work you did during the story already counts — scanned vehicles, studied animals, optional missions — so the cleanup is shorter if you scanned as you went.
Push Square is less relaxed about it: you do not need everything, it says, but you need almost everything.
Once the checklist hits 100%, the gold pops.

disputes.q: How long does the 100% cleanup take?
disputes.a: PowerPyx puts the whole platinum at about 200 hours.
disputes.b: Push Square says 250+ hours, 'up to 300 hours or more' in its intro.
disputes.call: Budget 200–300 hours; the checklist, not the story, is the long part.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: 250 stunts of any kind. PowerPyx counts 397 across Leonida, and 100% completion needs 300 — so keep going past the pop.

steps.t: Stunts are stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — PowerPyx counts 397 across Leonida.
You need 250 for the trophy; 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past the pop.
Turn on progress notifications in the UI settings so you can see what counts.
Stunt jumps are the bulk of the total — work them while exploring for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once. Most are available from Chapter 1.

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Most are available from Chapter 1 — fishing opens with Cal, and golf and the ranges are on the map early.
The tracker in this guide lists the nine; tick them as you try them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Nothing here is missable.

steps.t: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges; you need a gold medal in every one.
Ranges are an activity type, so each visit also counts toward Master of None.
100% completion needs the ranges done too — grind them after the story at your own pace.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. 100% completion needs them done as well.

steps.t: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations; win a race at each one.
100% completion needs the drone races done as well.
Racing is one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race type and location counts once.

steps.t: Win 20 different races — each race type and location counts once.
Racing is one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. He texts you a spot after you meet him in Chapter 1.

steps.t: Meet Cal in Chapter 1; he texts you a fishing spot afterwards.
Beat him in the fishing challenge at that spot.
Fishing is one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one in-game video game through to the end.

steps.t: Play any one in-game video game through to the end.
Three run on the TV at home and a fourth sits on arcade machines.
A video game is one of the nine activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand, Lucia only. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Andy's strand is Lucia only. It starts with a phone call in Chapter 3.
Finish every mission in the strand; the trophy pops on the final one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's treasure-diving strand: 7 shipwrecks. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so it is not missable.

steps.t: Kenton's strand is treasure diving — 7 shipwrecks in total.
Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's stranger strand at the mud club in Kelly County. It opens in Chapter 2.

steps.t: Billy's strand runs at the mud club in Kelly County and opens in Chapter 2.
Finish the strand; the trophy pops on the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only some side questlines count, and which ones is still being confirmed — finish the five named strands first, then any others that appear.

steps.t: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Only some side questlines count, and PowerPyx is still confirming which ones — the five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are the core, so finish those plus any others that appear.
It is not part of 100% completion, so it can still be open after the checklist is done — save it for the final cleanup stage.

disputes.a: PowerPyx is still confirming which side questlines count toward the 8.
disputes.b: The trophy text counts 'mission strands for strangers' — the five named strands plus any others that appear.
disputes.call: Finish all five named strands first, then any stranger strands that remain.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's stranger strand: a wish list of 16 sports cars. It opens in Chapter 3.

steps.t: Randy's strand is a wish list of 16 sports cars; it opens in Chapter 3.
Deliver every car on the list; the trophy pops on the last one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's stranger strand: shutting down labs in Vice City. Jason only, from Chapter 3.

steps.t: Tyrone's strand is shutting down labs in Vice City; Jason only, from Chapter 3.
Finish the strand; the trophy pops on the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy that may be missable. Leonida has 18 meditations at 10 spots: eight free-roam spots count twice (once per character), the Chapter 1 balcony counts once, and the Ascent Mountain session counts once. 100% completion needs 15 of 18; the trophy needs all 18.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 balcony FIRST: the morning after the Down to Earth mission, Lucia says she will meditate and walks to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her and accept — it takes a minute and the spot is gone after Chapter 1.

Meditate with BOTH characters at each free-roam spot: Smooth Sand (sandbar west of Capri), Swamp (Buckskin Swamp dock), Worn Stone (Emerald River at Camp Moonflower), Red Rocks (Manifest Canyon), Water Wheel (ruined paper mill, south Moreau), Jutting Cliff (Mount Kalaga National Park), Waterfall (north-west of Tallaloko), Seaside (beach east of Waning Sands).

Each session raises your Focus stat. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; spots show as a purple icon on the map once you are close, and the map filter Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida lists them.
The Ascent Mountain session appears only after every other meditation is done — a new purple icon at the stone circle on the Mount Kalaga summit.
100% completion needs 15 of 18, so the checklist can be finished without the trophy — but the trophy needs all 18.
Each spot counts twice except the balcony (Jason only, 1) and Ascent Mountain (1): 16 + 1 + 1 = 18.

disputes.q: Does the Chapter 1 balcony meditation count toward the 18?
disputes.a: PowerPyx: it raises the counter by +1, but it is pending confirmation whether it is required for the trophy or whether 18/18 is reachable without it.
disputes.b: KeenGamer: the eight free-roam spots give 16, the balcony adds one and Ascent adds the 18th — the balcony is part of the 18.
disputes.call: Do the balcony in Chapter 1. It costs a minute and removes the risk either way.

disputes.q: Which county is the Swamp spot in?
disputes.a: KeenGamer and PowerPyx place Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County.
disputes.b: Another guide places Buckskin Swamp in Vice-Dale County.
disputes.call: Follow the dock by the lookout tower in Buckskin Swamp, whatever the county is called on your map.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, Jason only, from Chapter 2. Which animal triggers it is not yet confirmed.

steps.t: Hunt a unique animal for Bret; Jason only, from Chapter 2.
PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it — clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which 100% needs, should cover it.
Study animals through the binoculars as you go: 100% needs 100 of 255 studied, and you do not have to hunt them.

disputes.a: PowerPyx has not confirmed which animal triggers it.
disputes.b: Clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks should cover it.
disputes.call: Work Bret's decks; the trophy should pop along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18. 100% completion needs 15 of 18, so keep collecting past the trophy.

steps.t: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets out of 18.
100% completion needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy.
Cards are found across Leonida — pick them up while exploring for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count.

steps.t: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK phone app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count.
Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts toward Whip It Good, so scan everything you pass.
The same scans feed the vehicle count for 100% completion.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. 100% needs 70, so this pops on the way to the checklist.

steps.t: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges.
100% needs 70, so this pops on the way to the checklist.
Challenges cover everything from stunts to robberies — they accumulate while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner along and escape. Bank vault jobs give 4 stars anyway.

steps.t: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner along and escape the heat.
Possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2.
Bank vault jobs give 4 stars anyway, so it often pops during Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
PowerPyx says it pops about 30 seconds after the third shop.
Keep the wanted level alive between shops — do not outrun the police until the third robbery is done.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with WAiNK is enough — you do not have to drive them.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with WAiNK is enough — you do not have to drive them.
100% needs 200 of the 277 base model vehicles, so keep scanning past the trophy.
Scan every new vehicle as you meet it; the counter is the same one 100% uses.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gang members count; soldiers, police and civilians seem not to.

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
PowerPyx says gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to — pick a gang fight for it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and fly away from it.

steps.t: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west.

steps.t: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx found them at Mile Zero Air Station in the south-west.
Expect a heavy police response — plan an escape route before you climb in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 main mission.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
You need the Snap Gun, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you.
Go in quiet — if you are spotted the attempt fails, so try a quieter approach next time.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. There are 8 vaults and 100% needs all of them — the trophy is the halfway mark.

steps.t: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4.
There are 8 vaults in total and 100% needs all of them — the trophy is the halfway mark.
Bank jobs give a 4-star wanted level, which also sets up Hot Together.
PowerPyx names bank vaults the best late-game earner — the cash feeds Little Boxes and Treat Yo Self.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The first bank job counts, or a sticky bomb opens a truck's back door earlier.

steps.t: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
The first bank job counts, or you can blow open a truck's back door with a sticky bomb earlier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map. A plane is fastest.

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map.
A plane is the fastest way to cover the map.
Exploring also surfaces meditation spots, WAiNK scans and stunt jumps.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations.

steps.t: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs.
100% needs all 39 operations, so this is the first ninth of a longer grind.
Work one gang at a time and the counter climbs.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact method is not yet confirmed by any guide.

steps.t: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Exact method not yet confirmed by any guide — try the beach bars on Ocean Beach and watch for the in-game hint.

disputes.a: No guide has confirmed the exact method yet.
disputes.b: The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a beach bar is the likely spot.
disputes.call: Try Ocean Beach bars after the story; treat it as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is not yet confirmed.

steps.t: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
Exact method not yet confirmed — a showroom robbery that ends in a smash-out is the likely trigger.

disputes.a: No guide has confirmed the exact method yet.
disputes.b: The description points to a vehicle showroom smash-out — a robbery that ends by driving through the glass is the likely trigger.
disputes.call: Try a showroom robbery after the story; treat it as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down.

The robbery comes back later, so it is not missable.

steps.t: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

steps.t: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
